claim_one_line: THE FRAME AUDIT (an audit arc, at the owner's request; GENESIS v1.42): on the ruled branch only the single pieces of T(x)T are degenerate at omega -- Tbar(x)T (B1618's Dirac tensor; nine members in B1635's own sealed read-outs, e.g. 1 : 0.674 : 0.448) and mixed T(x)T couplings are not, so tau = omega's retirement stands as 'no hierarchy found', not as a degeneracy; 'no choice is made' in the weave's multiplier is scoped -- rho = lift^-1 against its conjugate is two binary conventions, the record's allows W45's weight 3/2 and B1636's symmetric weight-1 (golden) coupling, the conjugate neither (its weight-1 coupling is antisymmetric only), so the index and the golden coupling come with the same hand and the hand is not derived; and rho_theta(RL) shares its eigenlines only with order-3 stabilisers, rho_theta(RRL) only with order-2 ones, so one tau cannot give the TM1 reading's residual pair. 0 of 19.
